results.name: Recording begins at the intact zero frame and captures the real simulation
Seeking restores poses, rotations, velocities, stress, bonds and telemetry without touching the world
Rewinding before impact hides future cracks, contact records and future trajectories
Replay single-step reaches the recorded endpoint without advancing physics
Continuing after repeated replay produces the same physical result as uninterrupted simulation
Bounded pose storage retains the beginning, latest frame and discrete fracture history
Long recordings remain seekable from zero, even beyond the old 60-second telemetry window
A new experiment discards the previous recording and fragment trail identities
